data.name: PkgDesc_1192
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL (ventilation controller). Module status: emitted every 100 ms, in response to ID_MODE_CIVL and whenever a status bit changes. Carries fault and alarm flags (bits 0–47), the current operating-mode code and the measured %O₂.

data.name: PkgInfo_1192
data.value: Status bits (bytes 0–5), fault and alarm flags: • bit 47 — ET tube occlusion • bit 46 — valve occlusion • bit 45 — circuit occlusion • bit 44 — nebulizer fault • bit 43 — AutoLeak • bit 42 — external flow sensor connected • bit 41 — external flow module connected • bit 40 — restart occurred • bit 39 — oxygen sensor auto-calibration error • bit 38 — oxygen sensor auto-calibration algorithm running • bit 37 — alveolar recruitment maneuver • bit 36 — oxygen sensor initial-voltage memory failure • bit 35 — oxygen sensor calibration-coefficient error • bit 34 — flow generator fault (excessive power draw) • bit 33 — voltage reference fault for AD7738 • bit 32 — CAN transmission error • bit 31 — nebulizer running • bit 30 — no link with the gas mixer (SG) • bit 29 — differential pressure sensor fault for the exhalation valve flow sensor • bit 28 — expiratory line pressure sensor fault • bit 27 — inspiratory line pressure sensor fault • bit 26 — AD7738 ADC fault • bit 25 — oxygen sensor fault • bit 24 — exhalation valve fault • bit 23 — VLV_F- fault • bit 22 — VLV_F+ fault • bit 21 — VLV_Z- fault • bit 20 — VLV_Z+ fault • bit 19 — purge compressor fault • bit 18 — safety valve fault • bit 17 — flow generator fault (unspecified cause) • bit 16 — EEPROM fault • bit 15 — flow generator constants error • bit 14 — exhalation valve constants error • bit 13 — "flow-to-pressure" converter constants error • bit 12 — pressure sensor constants error • bit 11 — 12VA voltage error • bit 10 — 2.5VA voltage error • bit 9 — 5VA voltage error • bit 8 — 12V_VLV voltage error • bit 7 — 15VA voltage error • bit 6 — V_EMV voltage error • bit 5 — 27V_PWR voltage error • bit 4 — apnea • bit 3 — Pmax reached • bit 2 — breathing circuit occlusion • bit 1 — depressurization • bit 0 — no link with the control unit (BU) Data fields: • byte 6 — current active operating-mode code (as in ID_MODE_CIVL) • byte 7 — current %O₂ measured by the oxygen sensor

data.name: PkgDesc_1196
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Breathing parameters: measured inspiratory volume and the device's specific work for the current breath. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1196
data.value: Data fields (length 4 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — measured inspiratory volume [ml], averaged over the last 4 breath cycles • bytes 2–3 — device specific work for the current breath [0.01 J/l]

data.name: PkgDesc_1023
data.value: Output packet from the power supply (PWR). Notifies all CAN-bus devices that power will be cut about 5 s after the power button is pressed. Has the highest priority in the system.

data.name: PkgInfo_1023
data.value: Length 0 bytes. Carries no data — the mere presence of the packet is the "power-off" event.

data.name: PkgDesc_1025
data.value: Output packet from the power supply (PWR). Power-supply state: emitted once on restart and asynchronously every 100 ms. Carries the output voltage, battery charge level/current and status flags.

data.name: PkgInfo_1025
data.value: Data fields and flags (length 5 bytes): • byte 0 — power-supply output voltage [x·0.1 V + 10 V] • byte 1 — when charging: 255 — charging, 100 — charged; when discharging: charge level 0–100 % • bytes 2–3 — status word: • bit 0 — no 220 V mains voltage • bit 1 — fan fault • bit 2 — remaining battery charge lasts no more than 10 minutes • bit 3 — battery alarm (battery missing) • bit 4 — battery alarm (charge overcurrent or short circuit) • bit 5 — battery charge overvoltage • bit 6 — charger switch fault • bit 7 — speaker fault (open circuit) • bit 8 — external power connected • bit 9 — "bad" external power source • bit 15 — restart flag • byte 4 — alarm state: 0 — none, 1 — high priority, 2 — medium priority

data.name: PkgDesc_1058
data.value: Output packet from the CAN-Ethernet board (SCM). Module state: emitted in RUN mode in response to ID_SYNHRO, on USB-storage connect/disconnect and on debug-session stop. Carries Ethernet, SD-card and USB-storage flags.

data.name: PkgInfo_1058
data.value: Status word (length 4 bytes), bits 0–20: • bit 0 — Ethernet PHY access-chip error • bit 1 — active Ethernet network connection present • bit 2 — Ethernet full/half duplex • bit 3 — Ethernet speed 100/10 Mbaud • bit 4 — link on the control port • bit 5 — link on the data port • bit 6 — SDRAM healthy/faulty • bit 7 — microSD absent/present • bit 8 — building the file system on SD • bit 9 — SD-card wear-out (write resource exhausted) • bit 10 — SD-card exchange error • bit 11 — USB mass storage connected • bit 12 — FAT partition present on USB • bit 13 — writing the alarm journal • bit 14 — writing a screenshot • bit 15 — transferring the CAN log from SD to USB • bit 16 — writing the service journal • bit 17 — writing trends • bit 18 — service translation mode on (SERVICE_ON) • bit 19 — microSD sector-recovery error • bit 20 — SCM mode on (SCM_ON)

data.name: PkgDesc_1090
data.value: Output packet from the gas mixer (MIX). Module state: emitted every 100 ms, after processing ID_MODE_MIX and on status change. Carries O₂ pressure, atmospheric pressure, current mode and fault flags.

data.name: PkgInfo_1090
data.value: Data fields and flags (length 8 bytes): • byte 0 — oxygen-line pressure [0.1 atm] • bytes 1–2 — atmospheric pressure [mmHg] • byte 3 — current active mode (as in ID_MODE_MIX) • bytes 4–7 — status word: • bit 31 — O₂-line pressure sensor fault • bit 30 — absolute-pressure sensor (before flow generator) fault • bit 29 — O₂-line flow sensor fault • bit 28 — air-line flow sensor fault • bit 27 — voltage reference fault • bit 26 — AD7738 ADC fault • bit 24 — no link with the CIVL • bit 23 — no link with the control unit (BU) • bit 20 — mixing-chamber pressure sensor constants error • bit 19 — O₂-line flow sensor constants error • bit 18 — air-line flow sensor constants error • bit 15 — +12VA supply fault • bit 13 — CAN fault • bit 12 — 12V1 (13.2 V) proportional-valve supply fault • bit 11 — HEPA filter contamination • bit 0 — restart flag

data.name: PkgDesc_1093
data.value: Output packet from the gas mixer (MIX). Instantaneous air and oxygen flows (500 Hz). Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1093
data.value: Data fields (length 4 bytes, signed values): • bytes 0–1 — STPD air flow [0.01 l/min] • bytes 2–3 — STPD oxygen flow [0.01 l/min]

data.name: PkgDesc_1123
data.value: Output packet from the display controller (KIND). Inspired oxygen fraction. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1123
data.value: Data fields (length 1 byte): • byte 0 — inspired oxygen fraction [%]

data.name: PkgDesc_1154
data.value: Output packet from the metabolograph/sidestream capnograph (CAPNO1). Module state: emitted on status-bit change and in response to ID_SYNHRO. Carries the current state/shutdown code and mode flags.

data.name: PkgInfo_1154
data.value: Data fields and flags (length 4 bytes): • byte 0 — module state: • 0x00 — measuring • 0x01 — zero calibration • 0x02 — warming up • 0x03 — blockage • 0x04 — pneumatic-path drying • 0x05 — demo mode • 0x06 — line not connected • 0x10 — disabled by user • 0x11 — disabled, blockage • 0x12 — disabled, emitter fault • 0x13 — disabled, receiver fault • 0x14 — disabled, compressor fault • 0x15 — disabled, pressure-sensor fault • 0x16 — disabled, overheat • 0x17 — disabled, capnograph unused for over 1 h • 0x18 — disabled, cell flooded • 0x19 — disabled, purge failed • byte 1 — mode flags: • bit 0 — units (0 — mmHg, 1 — percent) • bit 1 — demo mode • bit 2 — sync (0 — internal, 1 — external) • bit 4 — N₂O measuring block present • bit 5 — O₂ measuring block present • bit 6 — measurements during breath pause • bit 7 — metabolograph (1) / capnograph (0) mode

data.name: PkgDesc_1156
data.value: Output packet from CAPNO1. Graph values for CO₂, N₂O and O₂ in RUN mode. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1156
data.value: Data fields (length 8 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — CO₂ partial pressure [0.1 mmHg], 0–115 • bytes 2–3 — CO₂ fraction [0.01 %], 0–15 % • bytes 4–5 — O₂ [0.1 %] (invalid without the FASTOXY option) • bytes 6–7 — N₂O [0.1 %] (invalid without the N2O option)

data.name: PkgDesc_1157
data.value: Output packet from CAPNO1. Measured CO₂ parameters at the end of the breath cycle. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1157
data.value: Data fields (length 5 bytes): • byte 0 — CO₂ concentration at end of exhalation [0.1 %] • byte 1 — CO₂ concentration at start of exhalation [0.1 %] • byte 2 — CO₂ partial pressure at end of exhalation [mmHg] • byte 3 — CO₂ partial pressure at start of exhalation [mmHg] • byte 4 — respiratory rate (0 = capnographic apnea)

data.name: PkgDesc_1168
data.value: Output packet from CAPNO1. Measured metabolic parameters. Contains no errors (0xFFFF — invalid value).

data.name: PkgInfo_1168
data.value: Data fields (length 8 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — VCO₂, CO₂ output per minute [ml/min] • bytes 2–3 — VO₂, O₂ consumption per minute [ml/min] • bytes 4–5 — RQ, respiratory quotient [0.01] • bytes 6–7 — REE, daily energy expenditure [kcal/day] • 0xFFFF — invalid values

data.name: PkgDesc_1184
data.value: Input packet to the CIVL. Module operating-mode control. Switching to RUN requires prior receipt of ID_PAR1/2/3_CIVL, ID_PARAPNEA_CIVL, ID_OPT_CIVL.

data.name: PkgInfo_1184
data.value: Data fields (length 1 byte). Byte 0 — operating mode: • 0 — STANDBY • 1 — RUN • 2 — Short Internal Test (KVT) • 3 — Full Internal Test (PVT) • 4 — exhalation valve calibration • 5 — inspiratory oxygen sensor calibration • 6 — FASTOXY calibration in the sidestream capnograph • 7 — pressure-sensor calibration (service) • 8 — exhalation valve check (service) • 9 — O₂ flow-sensor calibration in the mixer (service) • 10 — flow-generator calibration (service) • 11 — flow generation (service) • 12 — leak check (service) • 13 — technological pediatric mode (service) • 14 — air flow-sensor calibration in the mixer (service) • 15 — flow-to-pressure converter calibration (service) • 16–19 — emergency modes AR-1…PAR (service) • 21 — inspiratory oxygen sensor replacement • 22 — CIVL bootloader launch (service) • 23 — Initialization • 24 — pressure-sensor zero calibration by temperature • 25 — circuit test for nCPAP mode

data.name: PkgDesc_1187
data.value: Input packet to the CIVL. Ventilation parameters (part 1): ventilation mode, patient type, flow shape, trigger, PEEP, inspiratory/expiratory times.

data.name: PkgInfo_1187
data.value: Data fields (length 8 bytes): • byte 0: • bit 7 — pediatric/adult mode • bit 6 — "sigh" mode • bit 5 — flow shape (0 — square, 1 — decelerating) • bit 4 — trigger (0 — pressure, 1 — flow) • bits 3–0 — ventilation mode: 0 CMV/VCV, 1 CMV/PCV, 2 SIMV/PC, 3 SIMV/VC, 4 CPAP, 5 BiSTEP, 6 NIV, 7 APRV, 8 PCV-VG, 9 SIMV/DC, 10 iSV, 11 nCPAP, 12 CPAP+VS, 13 nIMV, 14 HF_O2 • byte 1 — PEEP [cmH₂O] (Plow in BiSTEP) • byte 2 — pressure trigger sensitivity [mmH₂O] • byte 3 — flow trigger sensitivity [0.1 l/min] • bytes 4–5 — inspiratory time [ms] (0xFFFF — auto) • bytes 6–7 — expiratory time [ms] (0xFFFF — auto)

data.name: PkgDesc_1188
data.value: Input packet to the CIVL. Ventilation parameters (part 2): tidal volume, plateau, PS/Pmax/Pt pressures, trigger window.

data.name: PkgInfo_1188
data.value: Data fields (length 8 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — tidal volume [ml] • byte 2 — plateau duration [%] • byte 3 — PS above PEEP [cmH₂O] • byte 4 — Pmax [cmH₂O] • byte 5 — Pt (target inspiratory pressure) [cmH₂O] (Phigh in BiSTEP) • byte 6 — trigger window [0–100 %] • byte 7 — end-of-inspiration trigger [% of Finsp_max] (0xFF — auto)

data.name: PkgDesc_1189
data.value: Input packet to the CIVL. Ventilation parameters (part 3): pressure rise rate, graph rate, support flow, disconnection sensitivity.

data.name: PkgInfo_1189
data.value: Data fields (length 7 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — pressure rise rate [mmH₂O/s], 50–2000 • byte 2 — ID_WAVE_CIVL rate divisor (rate = 500/byte, at least 15 Hz) • byte 3 — support flow [l/min] • byte 4 — disconnection sensitivity [%] • byte 5 — deltaPEEP increment for the alveolar recruitment maneuver • byte 6: bit 0 — leak compensation (CMV/VCV); bit 1 — "free breathing"; bit 2 — neonatal/pediatric mode

data.name: PkgDesc_1190
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Graph data (flow, pressure, volume) in RUN mode. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1190
data.value: Data fields (length 8 bytes, signed values): • bytes 0–1 — flow referred to the patient wye [0.1 l/min] • bytes 2–3 — circuit pressure [mmH₂O] • bytes 4–7 — volume [0.1 ml]

data.name: PkgDesc_1193
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Error codes for sensor calibrations and other operations. Contents depend on the module's current operating mode (ID_MODE_CIVL).

data.name: PkgInfo_1193
data.value:
Byte 0 — response/error code; contents depend on the mode.
"Oxygen sensor calibration" mode: • 0 — calibration start • 1 — success (byte 1 — remaining sensor resource, %) • 2 — success, oxygen sensor replacement recommended • 3 — oxygen sensor missing or faulty • 4 — no/invalid atmospheric-pressure info • 5 — calibration cancelled • 6 — sensor voltage output (byte 1 — [0.1 mV]) • 7 — oxygen measuring channel in the CIVL faulty • 8 — flash write error • 9 — calibration progress percent (byte 1) • 10 — sensor voltage above previously stored value • 11 — sensor lifetime expired • 12 — new-sensor voltage too low • 13 — new-sensor voltage too high • 14 — error reading voltage from the file system
"Exhalation valve calibration" mode: • 0 — start; 1 — exhalation valve calibrated successfully • 2/3/4 — cannot reach pressure 10/30/50 cmH₂O • 5 — no expiratory flow • 6 — cannot reach zero expiratory flow when the flow generator stops • 7 — expiratory pressure over 2 cm at 10 l/min flow • 8 — large valve nonlinearity • 9 — FLASH write error; 10 — cancelled • 11 — exhalation-valve flow sensor not calibrated • 12 — expiratory-line pressure sensor not calibrated • 13 — differential pressure sensor for the valve flow sensor not calibrated • 14 — calibration curve at 20 l/min does not match reality
"Expiratory-line flow sensor calibration" mode: • 0 — start; 1 — success; 2 — update progress percent • 3 — gas-mixer failure; 4 — no response from the mixer • 5 — flow not zero; 6 — wrong data rate from the mixer • 7 — high inspiratory-line pressure • 8 — coefficient computation error • 9/10 — invalid pressure-sensor coefficients (inspiratory/differential) • 11 — no response from the power supply • 12 — power-supply temperature sensor faulty • 13 — low ambient air temperature • 14 — calibration task stopped • 15 — monotonicity error; 16 — coefficient write error • 17 — invalid expiratory pressure-sensor coefficient • 18 — byte 1 holds the max error
"KVT" mode: • 0 — start • 1/2 — inspiratory/expiratory pressure sensor not calibrated • 3 — no response from the mixer; 4 — wrong packet rate from the mixer • 5 — low ambient air temperature; 6 — power-supply temperature sensor faulty • 7 — cancelled; 8 — mixer fault; 9 — high inspiratory pressure • 10 — proceed; 11 — monotonicity error • 12 — coefficient write error; 13 — no response from the power supply • 15 — update progress percent • 16/17 — high/low circuit compliance • 18 — large circuit leak; 19 — exhalation valve does not close
"nCPAP circuit test" mode: • 0 — start; 1 — success • 2 — Paux sensor not connected to the wye • 3 — high inspiratory pressure • 4 — Paux pressure sensor did not calibrate • 5 — inspiratory pressure sensor did not calibrate • 6 — initial Paux pressure over 1 cm; 7 — cancelled

data.name: PkgDesc_1197
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Breathing parameters: measured expiratory volume. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1197
data.value: Data fields (length 4 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — expiratory volume [ml], averaged over 4 cycles • bytes 2–3 — expiratory volume without averaging [ml]

data.name: PkgDesc_1198
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Breathing parameters: PEEP, autoPEEP, wye flow and respiratory-tract time constant. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1198
data.value: Data fields (length 8 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — PEEP [mmH₂O] • bytes 2–3 — autoPEEP [mmH₂O] (0xFFFF — measurement error) • bytes 4–5 — wye flow with leak correction [0.1 l/min], signed • bytes 6–7 — respiratory-tract time constant [ms] (0xFFFF — error)

data.name: PkgDesc_1199
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Breathing parameters: measured respiratory rate. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1199
data.value: Data fields (length 2 bytes): • byte 0 — respiratory rate over the last minute [breaths/min] • byte 1 — spontaneous respiratory rate [breaths/min]

data.name: PkgDesc_1200
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Breathing parameters: peak pressure, dynamic compliance, stress index. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1200
data.value: Data fields (length 5 bytes): • byte 0 — peak inspiratory pressure [cmH₂O] • bytes 1–2 — dynamic compliance [0.01 ml/mmH₂O] • bytes 3–4 — stress index [0.01] (0xFFFF — measurement error)

data.name: PkgDesc_1201
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Breathing parameters: minute ventilation (total and machine). Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1201
data.value: Data fields (length 4 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — total MV over the last minute [ml/min] • bytes 2–3 — machine MV over the last minute [ml/min]

data.name: PkgDesc_1202
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Breathing parameters: measured expiratory time. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1202
data.value: Data fields (length 2 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — measured expiratory time [ms]

data.name: PkgDesc_1203
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Breathing parameters: inspiratory time and inspiratory time constant. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1203
data.value: Data fields: • bytes 0–1 — measured inspiratory time [ms] • bytes 2–3 — inspiratory time constant RCinsp [ms] (0 — dashes)

data.name: PkgDesc_1204
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Breathing parameters: static compliance and resistance. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1204
data.value: Data fields (length 4 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — static compliance [0.1 ml/cmH₂O] • bytes 2–3 — resistance [cmH₂O·s/l] • 0xFFFF — invalid value

data.name: PkgDesc_1205
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Circuit leak for the just-completed breath cycle (10 Hz). Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1205
data.value: Data fields (length 8 bytes, signed values): • bytes 0–1 — mean wye pressure over the cycle [mmH₂O] (0xFFFF — invalid) • bytes 2–3 — difference between inspiratory and expiratory volumes [ml] • bytes 4–5 — leak value [l/min] • bytes 6–7 — instantaneous leak to inspiratory flow ratio [%]

data.name: PkgDesc_1207
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Device operating time; emitted on request via ID_OPT_CIVL. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1207
data.value: Data fields (length 4 bytes): • bytes 0–3 — device operating time since manufacture [min]

data.name: PkgDesc_1219
data.value: Output packet from the protocol converter (PP, sidestream capnograph CAPNO2). Module state: emitted on status change and in response to ID_SYNHRO. Carries capnograph flags and the priority message.

data.name: PkgInfo_1219
data.value: Data fields and flags (length 8 bytes): • bytes 0–3 — capnograph status word (when byte 5 = 0): • bit 0 — negative CO₂ value (zero/adapter error) • bit 1 — adapter error • bit 2 — breath detected • bit 3 — high CO₂ (upper limit) • bit 4 — capnograph cannot start calibration • bit 5 — sleep mode active • bit 6 — apnea • bit 7 — closed (1) / open (0) circuit • bits 8–9 — temperature status (0 normal, 1 below, 2 above, 3 warming up) • bits 10–11 — zero-calibration status (0 not required, 1 active, 2 required, 3 error) • bit 12 — capnostat5 not initialized • bits 13–14 — current stabilizer (0 normal, 1 stabilizing, 2/3 hardware error) • bit 21 — hardware error • bit 22 — EEPROM faulty • bit 24 — sidestream adapter missing • bit 25 — pump resource exhausted • bit 26 — pneumatics error • bit 27 — hardware error • byte 4 — priority message: 0 none, 1 sensor overheated, 2 defective sensor, 3 atm pressure not set, 4 sleep mode, 5 zero correction, 6 warming up, 7 zero-measurement error, 8 high CO₂, 9 adapter error, 10 high sampling-line pressure • byte 5 — capnograph presence (0x00 — connected, 0x14 — not connected) • bytes 6–7 — atmospheric pressure [mmHg]

data.name: PkgDesc_1220
data.value: Output packet from the PP (CAPNO2). CO₂ graph data. Negative values may appear on zero/adapter errors — check the status.

data.name: PkgInfo_1220
data.value: Data fields (length 4 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — CO₂ partial pressure [0.01 mmHg], -75.00 to 15.00 • bytes 2–3 — CO₂ fraction [0.01 %], -9.99 to 19.70

data.name: PkgDesc_1221
data.value: Output packet from the PP (CAPNO2). Measured CO₂ parameters by breath phase and respiratory rate. 0xFF — invalid value.

data.name: PkgInfo_1221
data.value: Data fields (length 5 bytes): • byte 0 — CO₂ concentration at start of inhalation [0.1 %] • byte 1 — CO₂ partial pressure at start of inhalation [mmHg] • byte 2 — CO₂ concentration at end of exhalation [0.1 %] • byte 3 — CO₂ partial pressure at end of exhalation [mmHg] • byte 4 — respiratory rate [1/min] (0xFF — invalid)

data.name: PkgDesc_1223
data.value: Output packet from the PP (CAPNO2). Volumetric capnography parameters. 0xFFFF — invalid value.

data.name: PkgInfo_1223
data.value: Data fields (length 8 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — CO₂ elimination [ml/min] • bytes 2–3 — alveolar ventilation per minute [0.1 l/min] • bytes 4–5 — dead space per cycle [ml] • bytes 6–7 — alveolar ventilation per cycle [ml]

data.name: PkgDesc_1224
data.value: Output packet from the PP (CAPNO2). VCO₂ graph data. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1224
data.value: Data fields (length 4 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — VCO₂ wave [0.01 ml] • bytes 2–3 — VCO₂ integral [%]

data.name: PkgDesc_1249
data.value: Output packet from the Triton pulse oximetry module (SpO₂). Module state and measurements: emitted in response to ID_SYNHRO/ID_MODE_SPO and on status change. Carries perfusion, pulse, saturation and sensor state.

data.name: PkgInfo_1249
data.value: Data fields and state (length 7 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — perfusion [0.1 %] (≥1000 — dashes) • bytes 2–3 — pulse rate [bpm] (≥1000 — dashes) • byte 4 — saturation [%] (255 — dashes) • byte 5 — sensor/signal state (bits 0–3): • 0 — normal • 1 — module off • 2 — module faulty • 3 — sensor disconnected • 4 — sensor faulty • 5 — sensor reset • 6 — weak PPG signal • 7 — sensor degradation • byte 6 — module operating mode (as in ID_MODE_SPO)

data.name: PkgDesc_1253
data.value: Output packet from the SpO₂ module (Triton). Current operating parameters; emitted on request via ID_OPT_SPO. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1253
data.value: Data fields (length 4 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — PPG sampling rate • byte 2 — current analysis settings • byte 3 — reserved

data.name: PkgDesc_1284
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Device serial number. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1284
data.value: Data fields (length 4 bytes): • bytes 0–3 — device serial number

data.name: PkgDesc_1293
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Breathing parameters: measured expiratory volume (higher resolution). Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1293
data.value: Data fields (length 8 bytes): • bytes 0–3 — expiratory volume [0.1 ml], averaged over 4 cycles • bytes 4–7 — expiratory volume without averaging [0.1 ml]

data.name: PkgDesc_1294
data.value: Input packet to the CIVL. Ventilation parameters (part 5, higher resolution); take priority over ID_PAR1/2/3_CIVL.

data.name: PkgInfo_1294
data.value: Data fields (length 7 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — tidal volume [0.1 ml] • bytes 2–3 — set flow [0.1 l/min] • byte 4 — set ventilation rate RB [1/min] • bytes 5–6 — support volume Vsupp [0.1 ml]

data.name: PkgDesc_1296
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL (status 2). Additional fault flags; emitted right after ID_STATUS_CIVL every 100 ms. Its absence is not treated as a module no-response.

data.name: PkgInfo_1296
data.value: Status word (length 2 bytes), bits 0–11: • bit 0 — Jet flow sensor fault • bit 1 — Jet safety valve fault • bit 2 — Jet PWM regulator fault • bit 3 — ADC1 fault • bit 4 — respiratory-mechanics module fault • bit 5 — nCPAP pressure limit exceeded • bit 6 — Aux1 pressure sensor fault • bit 7 — system voltage (27V) fault • bit 8 — temperature/atm-pressure sensor fault on the CIVL board • bit 9 — set tidal volume unreachable (PCV-VG, SIMV/DC) • bit 10 — Paux does not match the set value • bit 11 — pressure 50 cmH₂O reached (nCPAP, HF O₂)

data.name: PkgDesc_1298
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Paux pressure graph (Paux1/Paux2 channels). Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1298
data.value: Data fields (length 4 bytes, signed values): • bytes 0–1 — Paux1 pressure [mmH₂O], -1020 to 1020 • bytes 2–3 — Paux2 pressure [mmH₂O], -1020 to 1020

data.name: PkgDesc_1299
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Paux pressure over the breath cycle (max/mean/min). Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1299
data.value: Data fields (length 6 bytes, signed values): • bytes 0–1 — maximum pressure over the cycle [mmH₂O] • bytes 2–3 — mean pressure over the cycle [mmH₂O] • bytes 4–5 — minimum pressure over the cycle [mmH₂O]

data.name: PkgDesc_1300
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Transpulmonary pressures and chest-wall compliance. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1300
data.value: Data fields (length 8 bytes, signed values): • bytes 0–1 — Ptpi, transpulmonary pressure at peak inspiration [mmH₂O] • bytes 2–3 — Ptpe, transpulmonary pressure at end of exhalation [mmH₂O] • bytes 4–5 — Ptpm, mean transpulmonary pressure over the cycle [mmH₂O] • bytes 6–7 — Ccw, chest-wall compliance [ml/cmH₂O]

data.name: PkgDesc_1304
data.value: Output packet from the CIVL. Averaged nCPAP pressure. Contains no errors.

data.name: PkgInfo_1304
data.value: Data fields (length 2 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — averaged nCPAP pressure [mmH₂O]

data.name: PkgDesc_1345
data.value: Output packet from the external flow sensor (EXTFLOW). Raw flow-sensor code and a data-validity flag. Rate is set by ID_MODE_EXTFLOW.

data.name: PkgInfo_1345
data.value: Data fields (length 3 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — code read from the flow sensor • byte 2: • bit 7 — no sensor data (error/initialization); the previous point is sent • bits 6–0 — number of averages (0 — conversion not finished)

data.name: PkgDesc_1409
data.value: Output packet from the Masimo pulse oximetry module (status 1). Measurements and sensor state: perfusion, pulse, saturation, PVI and validity.

data.name: PkgInfo_1409
data.value: Data fields and state (length 8 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — perfusion [0.001 %], normal 0.000–20.000 • bytes 2–3 — pulse rate [bpm], normal 0–240 • byte 4 — saturation [%], normal 0–100 • byte 5 — PVI [%], normal 0–100 • byte 6 — sensor state (bits 0–3): • 0 — normal • 1 — sensor not connected • 2 — sensor reset • 3 — sensor faulty • 4 — sensor degradation • 5 — weak PPG signal • 6 — connecting to the module • 7 — module absent • 8 — high interference level • 9 — sensor calibration • 10 — pulse search • 11 — incompatible sensor • 12 — module faulty • 13 — measurements unreliable • bits 4–7 — sensor type (SType) • byte 7 — validity bits (PI, PR, SpO₂, PVI, SType); bits 6–7 — operating mode (as in ID_MODE_SPO_V2)

data.name: PkgDesc_1410
data.value: Output packet from the Masimo module (status 2). Diagnostic error codes and sensor-fault detail; emitted right after ID_STATUS_SPO_V2_1.

data.name: PkgInfo_1410
data.value: Data fields (length 8 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — Exceptions 2 codes (Exc2), 0xNNNN • bytes 2–3 — Diagnostic Failure Codes (DFC), 0xNNNN • bytes 4–5 — Board Failure Codes (BFC) • byte 6: • bit 0 — PVI support • bits 1–3 — PVI error codes (0 normal, 1 Invalid PVI, 2 StartupState, 3 Low PVI Confidence) • bits 4–7 — "sensor faulty" detail (SFail): 0 none, 1 Open LEDs, 2 Shorted LEDs, 3 Shorted Detector, 4 Bad Sensor ID Offset, 5 Pro Cal Failure, 6 Memory Failure • byte 7 — validity bits (Exc2, DFC, BFC, PVI, SFail, Exceptions 3) and bit 7 — demo mode

data.name: PkgDesc_1449
data.value: Output packet from the motor controller (KM). Module state: emitted every 100 ms and on any bit change. Analyzed by the CIVL (bit 17 of ID_STATUS_CIVL).

data.name: PkgInfo_1449
data.value: Status word (length 1 byte), byte 0: • bit 0 — Hall sensors failure • bit 1 — motor driver failure (OCTW, DRV8301) • bit 2 — motor driver failure (FAULT, DRV8301) • bit 3 — reset bit (1 in the first packet after boot) • bit 5 — encoder failure • bit 6 — drive failure • bit 7 — critical failure (motor stop) Module failure = bits 0|1|2|5|6|7

data.name: PkgDesc_1451
data.value: Output packet from the motor controller (KM). Current flow-generator shaft angular speed and module state. Emitted in response to ID_SYNHRO and requests.

data.name: PkgInfo_1451
data.value: Data fields (length 3 bytes): • bytes 0–1 — current rotation speed [0.1 rpm] • byte 2 — status info (matches byte 0 of ID_STATUS_MOTOR)
